How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

python environments/textarena_env/build_tasks.py --verify

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download eltociear/textarena-tasks-v1 --repo-type dataset --local-dir textarena-tasks-v1

Needs: NLTK words corpus (network fetch at setup).
